name: Preparation of a Standard Solution
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT laboratory manual landing resources; exact Class 11 practical and page to verify
educational_goal: Practice accurate weighing, dissolution, transfer, and dilution while preparing a solution of known concentration.
safety_notes: Wear goggles and follow the reagent label.
Use a pipette filler rather than mouth pipetting.

scenes.description: A volumetric flask, funnel, balance, and labeled reagent are arranged on a clean chemistry bench during standard solution preparation.

steps.description: Calculate and weigh the required mass of a suitable soluble reagent.
steps.observation: The balance reading is recorded to the required precision.
steps.key_visual: The balance reading is recorded to the required precision.

scenes.description: A volumetric flask, funnel, balance, and labeled reagent are arranged on a clean chemistry bench during standard solution preparation.

steps.description: Dissolve the reagent in a small volume of distilled water in a beaker.
steps.observation: The solid dissolves to form a clear or uniformly colored solution.
steps.key_visual: The solid dissolves to form a clear or uniformly colored solution.

steps.description: Transfer the solution quantitatively into a volumetric flask and rinse the beaker.
steps.observation: Rinse portions are added so the dissolved material is transferred completely.
steps.key_visual: Rinse portions are added so the dissolved material is transferred completely.

scenes.description: A volumetric flask, funnel, balance, and labeled reagent are arranged on a clean chemistry bench during standard solution preparation.

steps.description: Make the volume up to the calibration mark and mix by inversion.
steps.observation: A homogeneous standard solution with known concentration is obtained.
steps.key_visual: A homogeneous standard solution with known concentration is obtained.
